title: FixtureSwap lost its keys
summary: According to Fixture DB, FixtureSwap lost $4,200,000 in a key compromise on November 23.
analysis: Second key-compromise drain on the fixture tracker this week.
oneFix: Keep long-term funds on a hardware wallet and never type its recovery phrase into a website.
corrections: Correction (2026-11-24): Example Wire now gives the figure as $4.8 million, not $4.5 million.
